scope: Immutable original ownership evidence for superseded Windows Move controls. This is a prerequisite for retirement admission and worker revalidation; no old records are deleted by this checkpoint.
implementation: Completion receipt format 2 includes each owner transaction/family, original private directory and parent labels/native IDs, plus the original central/local native file IDs, byte counts and SHA-256 default-stream hashes
Expected serialized records and opened native file contents are hashed through bounded streaming writers/readers; the control snapshot does not allocate another serialized cross-volume manifest
Opening a control denies concurrent writes/deletes during its snapshot and rejects nonordinary files; default-stream bytes must match the canonical record already proved complete
Reader validation binds the complete owner set and private topology back to the original completion binding; current labels or copied replacement files never refresh the original evidence
A completed recovery plan captures the ownership evidence before reducing its footprint to the local registry; its later receipt publication works after private folders disappear
Existing sealed completion acknowledgement does not reopen old volumes or files; the snapshot format rejects the superseded internal format 1 without a compatibility path
Cross-volume retained completion checks share one paired terminal predicate; no parallel recovery or Undo implementation was added

new_cases: Original central/local file IDs, byte counts and hashes match their actual opened native journals; copied central replacement and later changed local bytes do not alter the immutable evidence or get overwritten
A completed plan publishes the same captured control identities after both former payload/private containing folders have been removed, retaining its registry-only footprint

Cross-volume Replace captures both owners on different native volumes, validates each paired journal and rejects changed private identity, parent identity, hash or missing owner even after checksum recomputation
verification.offline: OFFLINE_PROOF.json records actual owned VHD detach, absent old drive, fresh ordinary process retry and native identity-checked reconnect with six file/directory/raw-link scenarios; restored data, edits, streams and unknown files are unchanged
verification.failure_teardown: The deliberate preparation/verification panic checks pass and remove their identity-admitted fixtures; their stderr intentionally contains caught panic messages
